title: Understanding Correlation
text: Correlation measures the strength and direction of a linear relationship between two variables. If two variables are uncorrelated, their correlation coefficient is $$0$$. Consider how BMI is calculated and how it might relate to height.

title: BMI Calculation
text: Recall that BMI is calculated using the formula: weight divided by (height divided by 100) squared. Think about how changes in height affect BMI when weight is constant.

title: Effect of Height on BMI
text: If height increases while weight remains constant, what happens to BMI?

title: Correlation Direction
text: Consider the direction of the relationship between height and BMI. If height increases and BMI decreases, what does this imply about the correlation?

title: Correlation Coefficient Sign
text: Given that height and BMI have an inverse relationship, what is the sign of the correlation coefficient?
